description: Source code for STM32 GPIO driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, interrupt handling, and port control functions.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for GPIO EXTI lines, fires registered callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_flags_to_conf
methods.description: Converts Zephyr GPIO flags to STM32 pin configuration settings.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_pincfg_to_flags
methods.description: Converts STM32 pin configuration to Zephyr GPIO flags.

methods.name: stm32_pinval_get
methods.description: Translates a GPIO pin number to the LL library pin value.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_configure_raw
methods.description: Configures hardware registers for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_clock_request
methods.description: Enables or disables the clock for the GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_set_exti_source
methods.description: Sets the external interrupt source for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_get_exti_source
methods.description: Retrieves the current external interrupt source for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_enable_int
methods.description: Enables external interrupt for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads the raw input value of a GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO port bits with masking.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits on a GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific bits on a GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific bits on a GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_config
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin or port with flags.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_stm32_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt triggering for a GPIO pin.
